clause: Component-property declaration model + instance-inspector typed fields [STU-DS-009]

scope.summary: Implement named component properties declared on a StudioComponent that surface on every instance's inspector as typed fields, decoupling instance-level configuration from variant explosion. This MT provides the declaration/schema model and the typed-field inspector rendering; the four property-type bindings are MT-334..MT-338. The property-type set is normative and enumerated in the spec.
expected_tests: argus: component-property editor + instance-inspector typed fields reachable via author_id
test: declared properties surface as typed fields on every instance; decoupled from variants
acceptance_criteria_original: component properties declared on component + surfaced as typed instance fields; author_id + manual entry

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-009] A `StudioComponent` MAY declare named component properties that surface on every instance's inspector as typed fields, decoupling instance-level configuration from variant explosion. The property-type set is normative and enumerated below; each type binds to a specific internal surface of the component. | Property type | Anchor | Binds to | Instance-level effect | |---|---|---|---| | Boolean | [STU-DS-010] | visibility of one or more nested layers | toggles sub-elements on/off without new variants | | Text | [STU-DS-011] | the content of one or more text layers | edits copy per instance from a named field | | Instance-swap | [STU-DS-012] | a nested `StudioComponentInstance` slot | swaps the nested component, constrained to an author-curated preferred-values list | | Exposed nested | [STU-DS-013] | properties of a nested instance marked "exposed" | surfaces the inner instance's own properties on the outer instance inspector | | Slot | [STU-DS-014] | a structural placeholder region | lets a consumer insert or replace arbitrary child content per instance |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
